description: The Animal Spirits meter for one coin: how strong the belief network around it is (0-100: how many people hold a view, in how many communities, how firmly, how much they agree) and what it feels (-100 panic to +100 euphoria, plus the share of each emotion and the bullish/bearish split), over the last 30 days. One person is one voice. status=not_enough_data when fewer than 5 people or 15 messages. Crowd mood, not a price forecast. No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.

symbol.description: coin ticker, name or dashboard slug, e.g. SOL, Pepe, Chainlink
